emails.subject: Helping shoppers build an OSEA routine
emails.body:
Hi OSEA team,

Your site guides shoppers across face, body, concern-based, pregnancy and postpartum, fragrance-free, and travel categories, alongside a skin quiz and subscription options. That breadth can make it difficult for a shopper to know which products belong in a routine—or which sets and add-ons fit their needs.

BuyScout.ai adds a Shopify Store Agent that can answer product questions, recommend routines, compare options, and suggest relevant cross-sells in the storefront. Beauty is one of our strongest use cases, with customer stories reporting higher multi-product baskets.

Would a 15-minute conversation about OSEA’s product-discovery experience be useful?

BuyScout.ai team
personalization_notes: OSEA organizes products by skincare category and concern.
The site promotes a 'Build Your OSEA Malibu Routine' skin quiz.
The site offers sets and subscriptions, creating recommendation and cross-sell opportunities.
Beauty is a BuyScout.ai proof category; customer-story metrics are reported outcomes, not guarantees.

emails.subject: Reducing phone-model choice friction
emails.body:
Hi Pela team,

Pela’s storefront covers a wide range of iPhone, Google Pixel, and Samsung Galaxy models, then extends into AirPod cases, straps, grips, wallets, cables, and MagSafe accessories. That gives shoppers plenty of choice, but also creates compatibility questions and opportunities to miss a useful add-on.

BuyScout.ai adds a Shopify Store Agent that can help shoppers identify the right model, compare case options, and recommend compatible accessories during the buying journey. Electronics and accessories are a core BuyScout.ai use case, including reported gains from product attachment in a customer story.

Would you be open to a 15-minute discussion?

BuyScout.ai team
personalization_notes: Pela lists extensive Apple, Google, and Samsung model coverage.
The site sells several accessory categories beyond phone cases.
The homepage promotes a buy-one-get-one case offer and a free mini wallet at a purchase threshold.
Electronics/accessories is a BuyScout.ai proof category; reported outcomes are not guarantees.

emails.subject: Making oral-care product choice easier
emails.body:
Hi COCOLAB team,

Your storefront spans Cocofloss, Cocoshine, Cocobrush, refills, kids products, gifts, flavor variants, and subscription options—and it also invites shoppers to take a smile-care quiz. That breadth can leave shoppers wondering where to start, which format they need, or what to add to a routine.

BuyScout.ai gives Shopify stores a conversational Store Agent that can answer product questions, recommend routines, compare options, and surface relevant bundles or refills. Beauty and wellness are strong BuyScout.ai use cases, with customer stories reporting improved multi-product baskets.

Would a short 15-minute call be worthwhile?

BuyScout.ai team
personalization_notes: COCOLAB offers a 'Your smile care starts here' product quiz.
The catalog spans floss, brushes, toothpaste, refills, kids products, gifts, and bundles.
The site distinguishes spool-and-dispenser and refill variants.
The site publishes a partnerships@cocolab.com address suitable for exploratory outreach.
Beauty/wellness proof points are reported customer-story outcomes, not promises.
